title: Hearty Smoked Egyptian Bread Flatbread
description: A salty, crumbly, and energizing Egyptian dish featuring crusty bread, this smoked flatbread is perfect for a snack or light meal, and is FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, smoked salt, yeast, and smoked paprika.
Gradually add the olive oil and water to the dry ingredients, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired flatbread size.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Brush the tops with a little water, then sprinkle with sesame seeds and poppy seeds.
Cook the flatbreads for 1-2 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
